goal.en: Chat with a new classmate and find something in common.
goal.zh: 和新同學聊天，找到共同話題。

background: quiet school courtyard with wooden benches under a large maple tree, a small stone fountain, brick walls covered with ivy, a bike rack, warm afternoon sunlight

intro.en: After class, you sit on a bench in the courtyard with a sandwich.
intro.zh: 下課後，你拿著三明治坐在中庭的長椅上。

intro.en: A classmate with round glasses sits down at the other end of the bench.
intro.zh: 一位戴圓框眼鏡的同學在長椅另一端坐了下來。

lines.en: Hey, you're in Ms. Reed's class too, right? I'm Leo.
lines.zh: 嘿，你也是瑞德老師班上的吧？我是里歐。

choices.en: Yeah! I'm Kai. Nice to meet you.
choices.zh: 對啊！我是凱，很高興認識你。
choices.tip: 對方先自我介紹時，回一句 I'm... Nice to meet you.，對話就自然開始了。

choices.en: Yes, I am. Ms. Reed is my teacher.
choices.zh: 對，我是。瑞德老師是我的老師。

lines.en: Uh, yeah, same class. So... do you have a name?
lines.zh: 呃，對，同一班。所以……你叫什麼名字？

story.en: Leo waits for your name, but you just nod. He finishes his sandwich in polite silence.
story.zh: 里歐等著你說名字，你卻只是點點頭。他在禮貌的沉默中吃完了三明治。

fail.why: 英語閒聊的習慣是：對方報上名字，你也要報上自己的名字。只回答 Yes, I am. 會讓對話卡住。要說 Yeah! I'm Kai. Nice to meet you.。

choices.en: Yes! My name Kai. Nice meet you.
choices.zh: 對！我叫凱，很高興認識你。

lines.en: Mai-name-kai? Is that all one word?
lines.zh: 麥內姆凱？那是一個字嗎？

story.en: For the next week, Leo calls you "Mynamekai." It takes a while to fix.
story.zh: 接下來一整週，里歐都叫你「麥內姆凱」。花了好一段時間才改過來。

fail.why: My name Kai 少了動詞 is，Nice meet you 少了 to。完整說法是 My name is Kai. 和 Nice to meet you.，或簡單說 I'm Kai.。

lines.en: Nice to meet you too! It's my first week here. Kind of crazy, right?
lines.zh: 我也很高興認識你！這是我來的第一週，有點瘋狂對吧？

choices.en: Totally. So, where are you from, Leo?
choices.zh: 真的。那你是哪裡人呢，里歐？
choices.tip: Where are you from? 是認識新朋友最常用的問題。先回應對方，再順勢反問，對話就能延續。

choices.en: Yes, crazy. You are which country people?

lines.en: Which country... people? Sorry, I don't get it.
lines.zh: 哪個國家……的人們？抱歉，我聽不懂。

story.en: Leo tries to put your words in order like a puzzle. After a while, he gives up and checks his phone.
story.zh: 里歐試著把你的字像拼圖一樣重新排列。過了一會兒，他放棄了，開始滑手機。

fail.why: 「你是哪國人」照中文語序說成 You are which country people，英文沒有這種說法。問對方從哪裡來，說 Where are you from? 就好。

choices.en: Yes. By the way, how old are you?

lines.en: Uh... why do you ask? Do I look old?
lines.zh: 呃……為什麼這樣問？我看起來很老嗎？

story.en: Leo feels like he is at a job interview. The chat ends quickly after that.
story.zh: 里歐覺得自己好像在面試。聊天很快就結束了。

fail.why: 在台灣，問年齡常是為了決定稱呼，但英文文化裡，剛認識就問 How old are you? 會讓人覺得太私人。先問 Where are you from? 比較自然。

lines.en: I'm from Busan, in Korea. How about you?

choices.en: I'm from Taiwan. What brings you here?
choices.zh: 我來自台灣。你怎麼會來這裡？
choices.tip: What brings you here? 是「什麼原因讓你來這裡？」的自然問法，比 Why are you here? 柔和許多。

lines.en: Why am I here? Um... should I leave?
lines.zh: 我為什麼在這裡？呃……我是不是該走了？

story.en: Leo picks up his sandwich and moves to another bench. Now you have the whole bench to yourself.
story.zh: 里歐拿起三明治，換到另一張長椅。現在整張長椅都是你的了。

fail.why: Why are you here? 語氣很直，聽起來像在質問「你幹嘛在這裡」。想知道對方來的原因，問 What brings you here? 會溫和很多。

choices.en: I'm come from Taiwan. Why you come here?
choices.zh: 我來自台灣。你為什麼來這裡？

lines.en: Sorry, you lost me there. Can you say that again?
lines.zh: 抱歉，我沒跟上。可以再說一次嗎？

story.en: You try three more times and get more nervous each time. Leo smiles politely and says he has to go to the library.
story.zh: 你又試了三次，一次比一次緊張。里歐禮貌地笑笑，說他得去圖書館了。

fail.why: I'm come 把 be 動詞和一般動詞放在一起，要說 I'm from Taiwan. 或 I come from Taiwan.。問句也要加助動詞：Why did you come here?，更自然的是 What brings you here?。

lines.en: I want to be a tour guide, so I need better English.
lines.zh: 我想當導遊，所以英文要變好。

lines.en: And I hear the hiking here is amazing!
lines.zh: 而且聽說這裡爬山超棒的！

choices.en: No way, me too! I love hiking.
choices.zh: 真的假的，我也是！我超愛爬山。
choices.tip: 聽到共同興趣時說 No way, me too!，再補一句自己的喜好，話題就接上了。

choices.en: Me too! I very like climb mountain.

lines.en: Climb mountains? Like with ropes and stuff? That's hardcore.
lines.zh: 攀登高山？要用繩索那種嗎？也太硬派了吧。

story.en: Leo now thinks you are a serious mountain climber. He asks you to lead a hike up the highest peak in the area.
story.zh: 里歐以為你是專業登山家，還請你帶隊攀登附近最高的山峰。

fail.why: 「爬山」直譯成 climb mountain，會讓人以為是攀岩或登高峰。一般健行說 go hiking 或 I love hiking.。另外 very 不能直接修飾動詞，要說 I really like...。

choices.en: Oh. By the way, is the cafeteria good?
choices.zh: 喔。對了，學生餐廳好吃嗎？

lines.en: The cafeteria? Uh... I guess it's OK?
lines.zh: 學生餐廳？呃……應該還行吧？

story.en: Leo was excited to talk about hiking, but you changed the topic. The chat ends with a long, polite silence.
story.zh: 里歐本來很想聊爬山，你卻換了話題。聊天在一陣漫長又客氣的沉默中結束。

fail.why: 對方主動分享興趣（hiking）時，就是找共同話題的好機會。突然跳到不相關的話題，會讓人覺得你沒在聽。可以接 No way, me too!，或 Oh, really? Where do you want to go?。

lines.en: Seriously? We should go hiking together sometime!
lines.zh: 真的嗎？我們改天一起去爬山吧！

story.en: You and Leo swap numbers before the bell rings. Maple Bay suddenly feels a little less lonely.
story.zh: 鐘聲響起前，你和里歐交換了電話號碼。楓灣突然感覺沒那麼孤單了。

notes.explain: 認識新朋友最常用的問題，回答用 I'm from + 地方。不要說 You are which country people?。

example.en: I'm from Taipei. Where are you from?
example.zh: 我來自台北。你是哪裡人？

notes.explain: 詢問對方來這裡的原因，語氣比 Why are you here? 柔和得多。也可以說 What brings you to Maple Bay?。

example.en: So, what brings you to Maple Bay?

notes.explain: 聽到和自己一樣的興趣或經驗時的熱情回應，是找共同話題的好幫手。

example.en: You like spicy food? No way, me too!
example.zh: 你喜歡吃辣？真的假的，我也是！

notes.explain: 中文的「爬山」多半是健行，英文說 go hiking。climb a mountain 聽起來像攀登高峰，要用到專業裝備。

notes.en: Don't ask someone's age right away.
notes.explain: 在台灣問年齡常是為了決定稱呼，但在英語文化中，剛認識就問年齡、薪水、感情狀況都太私人。先聊來自哪裡、興趣比較安全。

example.en: Where are you from? What do you do for fun?
example.zh: 你是哪裡人？平常喜歡做什麼？
